entries.zh: 卒（一瞬间就完了、霎时终结）
entries.en: finished/undone in a moment; suddenly over

entries.notes: source_H「喪」与 acabado deshecho 对应取丧败义，闽音 sóng 支持丧败而非丧礼。

entries.zh: 殘（完了、过完了；如时间已过）
entries.en: to be over, past (as time); used up
lamp burnt out; its oil spent

entries.zh: 做成（做成完工、圆满完成）
任满（任期届满，法官或长官卸任）
entries.en: term of office completed; to finish one's term as judge or prelate

entries.zh: 定叠了（定妥办完、一切收拾停当）
entries.en: settled and done; finished and put in order
entries.notes: 「定叠」为闽语口语词（收拾妥当），依汉字与西语释义推得。

entries.zh: 断根（除根断绝、彻底了结讼案）
entries.en: to cut at the root; finish a lawsuit once for all

entries.zh: 结果（到底完结、终成结果）
entries.en: to finish well to the end; outcome

entries.zh: 竭尽（竭尽用光、用到尽头）
entries.en: to exhaust, use up to the end

entries.zh: 衰微（衰败削减、所剩无几）
entries.en: wasted away, dwindled; nothing left over

entries.zh: 随手成（随手做成、一举而成）
entries.en: done perfectly at a stroke; finished on the spot

entries.zh: 缴结（办结缴清、结案了结）
事明白（事情明白清楚、了结分明）
entries.notes: 汉法混合词序（事+明白），依西语 acabado concluido 取事毕明白义。

entries.zh: 定奪（定夺决定、议定完结）
易过（容易过去、轻易度过）
entries.en: to pass easily; be got over without difficulty

entries.zh: 晴（哄止哭闹、使安静下来）
entries.en: to hush/soothe one who weeps; calm down
entries.notes: 单字「晴」在此取转晴平息义以对应 acallar，仅依四栏互推，故降中等。
